resources.string: Which way the stream may turn. Automatic keeps phones in landscape and lets tablets turn; Landscape, Reverse landscape and Portrait lock it; Rotate with device follows the device. Landscape (either side) turns over with the phone even when rotation is locked.
This PC keeps the stream’s shape while it runs, so the picture is scaled to fit the turned screen.
This device’s decoder cannot take the turned size, so the stream keeps its shape and is scaled to fit.
Screen flip isn’t available in windowed or external-display mode.
